creditLimit.title: Customer credit limits
creditLimit.intro: Limits are saved in the company base currency. Active periods of one customer cannot overlap, including the first and last day. Deactivated limits are kept as history.
creditLimit.customerLocked: The customer of a saved limit cannot change. To use another customer, deactivate this limit and add a new one.
creditLimit.amountHint: 0 to 999,999,999,999,999.9999, up to 4 decimals, no thousands separators. 0 means no credit sales.
creditLimit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount from 0 to 999,999,999,999,999.9999 with up to 4 decimals.
creditLimit.dateOrder: Enter a valid end date that is not before the start date.
creditLimit.historyOnly: Deactivated limits are history and cannot be edited or reactivated
creditLimit.empty: No credit limits are set for the current company.
creditLimit.noResults: No credit limits match these filters. Adjust the filters.
creditLimit.loadFailed: Credit limits could not be loaded.
creditLimit.invalidWindow: Enter valid dates, and "Period covers from" must not be after "Period covers to".
creditLimit.validationFailed: Some fields are invalid. Check the marked fields and save again.
creditLimit.created: Added the credit limit for {{customer}}: {{from}} to {{to}}, {{amount}} {{currency}} (version {{version}}).
creditLimit.updated: Updated the credit limit for {{customer}}: {{from}} to {{to}}, {{amount}} {{currency}} (version {{version}}).
creditLimit.deactivated: Deactivated the credit limit of {{customer}} for {{from}} to {{to}}. The record is kept as history.
creditLimit.deactivateContent: The limit for {{from}} to {{to}} cannot be reactivated. Add a new limit if credit is needed.

glPeriod.title: Accounting periods
glPeriod.intro: Each period covers its first and last day. Periods of one company cannot overlap, and a journal can be posted only to an Open period. Posted journals are never changed by editing, closing or reopening a period.
glPeriod.closedHint: Posting to these dates is rejected until the period is reopened.
glPeriod.invalidWindow: Enter valid dates; the start date of the window cannot be after its end date.
glPeriod.empty: No accounting periods have been set up for this company yet.
glPeriod.noResults: No periods match these filters. Change or reset the filters.
glPeriod.loadFailed: The periods could not be loaded. See the message above and retry.
glPeriod.createHint: A new period is always Open. Closing and reopening are separate actions in the list.
glPeriod.editStateHint: Only the dates change here; the period stays {{status}}. You are editing version {{version}}.
glPeriod.inclusiveHint: Both dates are included. The period cannot overlap another period of this company or leave out the date of a Posted journal.
glPeriod.dateOrder: Enter a valid end date on or after the start date.
glPeriod.closeContent: Period {{start}} – {{end}}: posting to these dates will be rejected until the period is reopened. Posted journals are not changed.
glPeriod.reopenContent: Period {{start}} – {{end}}: journals can be posted to these dates again.
glPeriod.deleteContent: Period {{start}} – {{end}} will be removed. A period that contains Posted journals cannot be deleted.
glPeriod.closed: Period {{start}} – {{end}} is now Closed (version {{version}}); posting to these dates is rejected.
glPeriod.unchangedDates: No change was saved: the period already has the dates {{start}} – {{end}} (version {{version}}).
glPeriod.unchangedClosed: No change was saved: period {{start}} – {{end}} was already Closed (version {{version}}).
glPeriod.unchangedOpen: No change was saved: period {{start}} – {{end}} was already Open (version {{version}}).

glJournal.title: Posted journals
glJournal.intro: Journals posted from module source documents. Posted journals cannot be changed; a correction is posted from a new source document. Amounts are in the company base currency as saved.
glJournal.periodsFailed: The period list could not be loaded, so periods are shown by number. The journal list is not affected.
glJournal.invalidRange: Enter valid dates; the business date from cannot be after the business date to.
glJournal.invalidSourceId: Source ID must be a positive whole number.
glJournal.empty: No journals have been posted for this company yet.
glJournal.noResults: No Posted journals match these filters. Change or reset the filters.
glJournal.loadFailed: The journals could not be loaded. See the message above and retry.
glJournal.immutableHint: This journal is Posted and read-only. Account names and versions are the snapshot saved at posting time.
